text:
cecilia: quick update — Sparrow-batcher v3 rolled to production (hosted + dedicated in us-east-1 and eu-west-1). short win: p50 token -2.8ms, p99 token -24ms, token-cost ~-16% on webchat workloads. low-risk rollout, details below. :tada:

ishaan: sweet. what percentage did you ramp before full promote?

cecilia: ramp plan: 5% -> 50% canary over 4h, then 100% promote after no red flags. A/B id: sparrow-v3-prod-2026-03.

sam: how did we compute the cost reduction? any caveats on longer sequences (>1024)?

cecilia: cost is from combined per-token GPU cycles + batching uplift in the A/B. we also simulated longer seqs— no sig regressions in our sample for seq up to 4096. small tail variance but within alert thresholds.

laura: did you tweak KV cache behavior? i noticed a config change in the canary.

cecilia: yes, we biased eviction toward prefix affinity to favor short-dialog cache hits. config excerpt:
```
batcher.name=sparrow_v3
batcher.coalesce_window_ms=6
batcher.max_batch_tokens=4096
batcher.prefer_prefix_cache=true
batcher.adaptive_evict_threshold=0.85
```

jordan: i'll add the sparrow_v3 tag to perf dashboards and billing impact view. please attach the bench artifact when you have it.

ops-bot: Deploybot: Sparrow-batcher-v3 promoted to 100% in us-east-1 at 09:45 UTC (release infra/sparrow/v3).

sam: can someone paste the local repro command? want to run a microbench on my laptop perf VM.

cecilia: repro command:
```
./runtest --suite=sparrow-latency --model=redwood-base-4k --qps=200 --seq=512 --dur=300
```

ishaan: let's keep eyes on p99 for low-traffic models. can we run a quick check in 2 hours?

cecilia: scheduled monitor job perf-alert:sparrow_v3_p99 every 15m, compare to baseline. pinged @oncall.

ops-bot: Oncall: perf check scheduled at 11:30 UTC (job id perf-2777777346).

sam: what's rollback look like if we see problems?

cecilia: rollback command in release doc: `infra-promote sparrow_v2 --region $REGION` (requires infra-sudo). added to release notes.

laura: thanks team  party emoji  — i will draft a short internal note for product & customer comms highlighting the cost/latency deltas and safe rollout.

jordan: i'll also pin a follow-up thread tomorrow with the full bench tables and raw A/B dashboards.

cecilia: plan: publish detailed bench writeup tomorrow with sample sizes, pXX numbers, seq stratified analysis, and the A/B dashboard link. ping me if you see oddities.

ishaan: nice work, big win. :rocket:

laura: LGTM, closing the loop on this thread.
